payload.description_html: Bicharracosaurus is a large macronarian sauropod, possibly a brachiosaurid. Like all sauropods, this dinosaur walked on four pillar-like legs and used its long neck to reach vegetation which it processed in its large gut. Bicharracosaurus is estimated at approximately 15 m in total body length, and weighed around 20 t.
